narrative.northStar: 学习桌面 / The Study Desk
narrative.overview: edurec is a Chinese educational-resource recommender. Its interface is a calm study desk: warm paper, deep ink, one vermilion pen. The home hero puts a real recommendation card on the desk, not an illustration; every page answers what to learn next and why. The previous transit-signage world is replaced by an editorial, warm, product-first system in Operate mode.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with white paper cards and deep ink type.
One vermilion signal for action and current state.
Editorial type scale with self-hosted Manrope for Latin/numerals and the system Chinese stack.
10px fields, 14px cards, 16px panels; pills only for chips and small controls.
Borders at rest, one ink-tinted hover lift, no ambient card shadows.
Deep-ink orientation panels with authored orbit geometry.
A fixed four-destination bottom tab bar on mobile.
rules: One Signal Rule: vermilion means act here or you are here; never a page wash or gradient.
Meaningful Color Rule: level/type colors only where they encode level, type, or state.
No-Eyebrow Rule: no decorative kicker or uppercase label above a heading.
Dark Panel Rule: ink panels are for orientation surfaces only.
Flat-by-default Rule: elevation is a hover response, not ambient decoration.
dos: Keep the paper/white/ink split and generous section spacing.
Use one vermilion signal and semantic level colors only where meaningful.
Use Manrope for Latin/numerals and tabular numerals for data.
Give every empty and error state a clear next action.
Keep keyboard focus rings and reduced-motion support.
donts: Do not reintroduce transit signage: navy rail bands, 2px route strokes, station dots, uppercase micro-labels, 4px corners.
Do not use gradient text, glass decoration, or colored halos.
Do not put a kicker above a heading.
Do not use pills for large containers or buttons.
Do not use ambient shadows on static cards.
Do not convey state by color alone.
